judge.rationale: The finding explicitly states the API handler writes directly to InventoryRepository, bypassing InventoryReservationService (criterion 1); it cites docs/decisions/ADR-004.md with its exact rule text rather than a generic layering preference (criterion 2); the proposed fix routes the write through InventoryReservationService (e.g., InventoryReservationService(InventoryRepository()).save(...)), preserving the single write path (criterion 3); and it cites api_handler.py with line numbers 7-8 (criterion 4).
